Automatic Execution Paths

  • pyproject.toml uses the standard hatchling.build PEP 517 backend; the provided content shows no custom build hook or install-time execution logic.
  • No .pth, sitecustomize.py, usercustomize.py, or setup.py was observed in the provided extraction/text.
  • [project.scripts] lestash = "lestash.cli.main:app" is a normal console_scripts entry point and requires the user to run the command, so it is not treated as malicious automatic execution.
  • __main__.py is also a normal entry point for python -m lestash.

Theft / Exfiltration / Persistence / Lateral Movement / Stealth

  • **Credential harvesting:** Not observed. The ANTHROPIC_API_KEY check appears to be a single documented application credential for the OCR feature’s Claude API call. There is no evidence of broad environment-variable discovery or collection of .env, SSH keys, cloud credentials, CI tokens, or registry tokens.
  • **Archive staging / exfiltration:** Not observed. base64.standard_b64encode(png_bytes) appears to encode an image for a user-triggered Anthropic SDK OCR request, not to stage or exfiltrate secrets.
  • **Persistence:** No evidence of systemd units, cron jobs, shell profile edits, launch agents, startup entries, or background persistence loops.
  • **Lateral movement:** No evidence of Kubernetes, Docker socket, cloud metadata, CI/CD token abuse, or GitHub Actions workflow injection.
  • **Obfuscation / loader:** Not observed. Pre-scan hits such as re.compile, “ampersand” strings, and logging handlers appear to be normal regex/documentation/logging code, not obfuscated loaders or dynamic execution.

Distribution Integrity Anomalies

  • No hidden payloads, unexplained native binaries, suspicious .dist-info manipulation, or typosquatting evidence was observed in the provided files.
  • The presence of .gitignore in the sdist is a common project metadata inclusion and is not sufficient evidence of malicious distribution tampering.
  • Dependencies related to Google APIs, Docling, PyMuPDF, and Anthropic appear consistent with the documented functionality; the provided data does not establish sudden malicious dependency insertion.
